answer: The Dedicated device bound by signed confirmation letter with annual re-verification makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a terrace is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. A dune and a summit may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
